name: Koizumi Mayu
source:
She’s the mysterious dorm leader who supposedly reads people’s minds. 3rd year. She doesn’t like people very much but she likes Shouko an awful lot. Feeds stray cats that comes to the dorm’s back yard. Also very mischievous. Loves fries.
